result.question: Why were the descendants of Dan looking for territory?

readings.answer: Because they had not yet come into an inheritance among the tribes of Israel.
readings.support: they had not come into an inheritance among the tribes of Israel

assessments.reason: Judges 18:1 states the Danites were seeking territory because they had not yet come into an inheritance among the tribes of Israel, matching the key’s meaning of not yet receiving an inheritance.

result.reason: The passage explicitly gives the reason: they had not yet come into an inheritance among the tribes of Israel.
